output.subject: Your questions about your auto loan payment due October 6
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for reaching out to us, and we're sorry to hear about the loss of your job. We know this can be a stressful time, and we appreciate you contacting us before your payment is due.

You told us you lost your job at the end of August and won't be able to make your auto loan payment of $318.00 due on Tuesday, October 6. You mentioned that you don't want to fall behind or hurt your credit. You asked whether there is a hardship program, or whether you could pay half this month and catch up afterward.

Our Consumer Lending team will review your questions about your loan, and we will respond within 10 business days. You let us know that the best time to reach you by phone is after 3pm, and we have noted that along with the number you gave us.

Thank you again for letting us know early.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: This is a request for help, not a complaint; customer is asking about hardship options before missing a payment.
Payment is due Tuesday, October 6, which may fall before the 10-business-day response window; decide whether to contact the customer sooner.
Decide which hardship, deferral or partial-payment options (if any) can be offered and add specifics.
Confirm what credit reporting impact, if any, a partial or late payment would have before addressing the credit concern.
Customer requested a callback after 3pm at the phone number they provided (⟦PHONE_1⟧); verify it against the number on file.
Verify the loan details, payment amount ($318.00) and due date against the account.
